The cause is that rimraf's test script invokes node-tap's own CLI reporter, whose pretty-printed summary format ('Asserts: N pass', 'Suites: N pass', a decorative TEST COMPLETE banner) is not one the harness's evidence parser currently recognizes as a completed suite - a real, structural harness limitation, distinct in kind from eslint's dependency-pinning gap. Per protocol this is evidence, not something to patch around (extending the parser to recognize a new reporter format is new engine scope, out of bounds for this pilot) - rejected, moving to the next rank.
